runs.description: Invocations the plugin infers, each a program and its arguments

applications.description: Bundle names of the applications the invocations archive, each invocation taking -archivePath <n>.xcarchive in a temporary folder, once every invocation succeeds each bundle under an archive's Products copied beside its path below / and swapped with the bundle installed there in one renamex_np, so a failed invocation leaves the installed bundle untouched, then each one holding Contents/Library/LaunchAgents launched once more with open -n -g -j -W, behind the user's windows, so its SMAppService registration replaces the agents still running the build it swapped out, and one whose Contents/MacOS holds the executable a running process launched from named in the last line as needing a relaunch

results.description: Result bundle paths, each removed before the first invocation runs, as xcodebuild refuses a result bundle path that exists, the invocation at a path's index writing its bundle through -resultBundlePath into a temporary folder that every bundle leaves for its path once the last invocation ends, as xcodebuild resolves the package graph again at each write under the root of a package it tests and invalidates the test bundles it runs

dryRun.description: Prints each invocation and runs none

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

outputs.description: Files the configuration writes, which the target's outputs name through {options.outputs.<n>}

title: Run
description: Runs swift and xcodebuild invocations in order with Nx's per-task environment removed and git status.branch off after the caller's GIT_CONFIG_<n> entries, stopping at the first failure
